description: Source code for a FastCGI module in the lighttpd web server, implementing FastCGI request handling, environment setup, and response parsing.

methods.name: mod_fastcgi_merge_config_cpv
methods.description: Merges specific plugin configuration values based on key id.

methods.name: mod_fastcgi_merge_config
methods.description: Merges plugin configuration values from a list.

methods.name: mod_fastcgi_patch_config
methods.description: Patches plugin configuration based on current request and plugin data.

methods.name: mod_fastcgi_set_defaults
methods.description: Initializes default configuration for the FastCGI module.

methods.name: fcgi_env_add
methods.description: Adds environment variables to FastCGI environment buffer.

methods.name: fcgi_header
methods.description: Constructs a FastCGI header with specified parameters.

methods.name: fcgi_stdin_append
methods.description: Appends request body data to FastCGI stdin stream.

methods.name: fcgi_create_env
methods.description: Creates and sends FastCGI environment and request initiation packets.

methods.name: fastcgi_get_packet
methods.description: Parses a FastCGI packet header from the input buffer.

methods.name: fastcgi_get_packet_body
methods.description: Extracts the body content of a FastCGI packet.

methods.name: fcgi_recv_0
methods.description: Handles end-of-file or connection closure during FastCGI response.

methods.name: fcgi_recv_parse_loop
methods.description: Parses incoming FastCGI packets and processes response data.

methods.name: fcgi_recv_parse
methods.description: Main entry point for parsing incoming FastCGI data.

methods.name: fcgi_response_headers
methods.description: Handles response headers after FastCGI response is received.

methods.name: fcgi_check_extension
methods.description: Checks if the request URI matches FastCGI extension rules and initializes handler context.

methods.name: fcgi_check_extension_1
methods.description: URI path handler for FastCGI extension matching.

methods.name: fcgi_check_extension_2
methods.description: Start request handler for FastCGI extension matching.

methods.name: mod_fastcgi_plugin_init
methods.description: Initializes the FastCGI plugin, setting function pointers for request handling.
